rules: rule 2: a portal's height comes from its own road's approach, from the approach's line over its last 20 m (grading.portal_end_profile: samples more than 0.5 m over the Theil-Sen line of that stretch set onto it), never from one DEM sample over the mouth
rule 1: the tunnel is the tagged range (w36926434 eastbound, w10042282 westbound: is_tunnel, layer=-1)
rule 6: a town tunnel under thin cover is a cut-and-cover box (here both tubes: 'town')

rule_vs_prototype.rule: T1 rule P: a portal moves outward by at most X_MAX 30 m (100 ft) where the bare ground just outside the mapped end stands more than D_CUT (15 m rural / 8 m town) over the profile; never inward
rule_vs_prototype.prototype: never moved: the portal stays at the mapped end (rule 2)
rule_vs_prototype.here: no snap in this case (t1_actual.snaps is empty): both agree

rule_vs_prototype.rule: the maintainer: the floor is the profile's (prof.rs) within its grade limits, not forced straight pin to pin; measured floors win
rule_vs_prototype.prototype: rule 3: the lower hull of the ground between the pins, sunk where the cover over the crown is under 1 m (MAPPED_COVER_M), rounded over 12 m
rule_vs_prototype.here: floor_at values are 'prototype' (reference, +-0.30 m); portals and joints are the pins both agree on

rule_vs_prototype.rule: T1: kind 2 (full) where the axis cover >= TUBE_H 6.8 + LID_MARGIN 0.5 = 7.3 m, else kind 1 (lid); the maintainer's later split: bore at >= 8 m cover over >= 60 m, thinner a box, under the opening + 0.45 m a lid box
rule_vs_prototype.prototype: decided per mapped part: a town tunnel (buildings within 30 m) under a median cover over the crown below BOX_COVER_M 4 m is a cut-and-cover box end to end (4.70 m clear + 0.80 m roof), else a bore (6.8 m); a low arch only where the cover sizes it down
rule_vs_prototype.here: expected.t1.expected_from_prototype codes a box as 2 ('full', label box_town); T1 itself gives 1 (lid) where the box's cover is under 7.3 m (near the mouths): see t1_actual

rule_vs_prototype.rule: the maintainer: maxheight + 10 in (else a table by class and country) + 1 ft
rule_vs_prototype.prototype: a box 4.70 m clear (RABT 4.50 m + margin), a bore's tube 6.8 m

rule_vs_prototype.rule: TUBE_H 6.8 (also for a box), X_MAX 30, D_CUT 15 / 8, GAP_COVER 2, GAP_MIN_M 40, MIN_RUN_M 10, HOLE_OVER 1, HOLE_MAX_M 60
rule_vs_prototype.prototype: box section 5.5 m over the floor (the terrain is cut and raised to the roof's top), open gaps inside a mapped part never (covered end to end), no lid / full split inside a part

notes: The eastbound mouth (w36926434 at 47.97949, 7.90731) took the DEM over the mouth as its road's height before the rule: one lidar pixel 4.8 m over the road (portal_end_profile[0].input_ground[0] = 326.44 m vs the line's 321.58 m), the floor 5.3 m over its own road 5 m out and 4.7 m over the westbound's beside it.
With the rule the floor (321.62) meets the approach line (321.58) within 0.05 m; tunnelscan's mouth_step, blocked and portal_high are 0 at both portals.
The window starts inside the Kappler Tunnel (eastbound s 0 = feature station 3100, joined at its start): T1 sees the range's west end as a joint, no portal there.

T1 (t1_actual, kmh 80: rural D_CUT 15 m): no snap; eastbound full inside, lid 210-222 m by the east mouth (cover under 7.3 m) with a 12 m hole; westbound lid 32.8-80 m from the mouth (hole 47.2 m), then full.
Known rests in check_rows: town_bank 2 (the approaches' banks east of the portals), outside_no_edge 2.
The OSM building=roof (way 385892896) drawn over the east portals was deleted in OSM on 2026-11-24; the prototype also leaves a building=roof over a tube's portal zone out.
